text:
Marco: quick idea — current scrub + sampling loses the ability to tie a sampled request back to the original field. ops can't replay incidents with confidence. we should consider a 'fieldline' id approach for replay-safe logging.
Priya: curious, what's a fieldline id? how's it different from hash/pseudonymization we've discussed?
Marco: short: deterministic, per-tenant pseudo-id for each sensitive field value, derived with tenant KMS so it can't be reverse-engineered. keeps provenance for debugging without storing raw PII.
Sam: sounds promising. would this require storing a mapping? that'd be annoying for retention/exports.
Marco: no mapping stored. compute HMAC(field_value, tenant_key) on ingest, store hex id. ops can correlate occurrences but cannot recover original value.
Katie: example?
Marco: ```
// pseudo
field_id = HMAC_SHA256(tenant_kms_key, utf8(field_value))
// store: { field: "email", field_id: "ab3f...", redact: "***" }
```
Priya: ok but replaying: if we only have field_id and scrubbed value, how does one replay an exact payload? some debuggers re-run the original request.
Marco: we wouldn't allow re-run with raw PII. create a replay-safe surrogate generator that synthesizes similar-but-nonidentical values driven by the field_id and schema. debug tools replay with surrogates, not real PII.
Sam: hmm. so two modes: "investigative" (surrogates) and "audit" (real values accessible only under strict legal/ops workflow).
Katie: who approves audit unredact? legal + sec + oncall lead? need an ops flow.
Juli: we already have a breakglass flow for inspect. extend it: require CSR ticket + 2FA + ephemeral decryption that logs who decrypted.
OpsBot: deploy-checker: canary flag "fieldline-enabled" set on eng-platform for next deploy.
Priya: switching to sampling: if we sample 1% of requests, we still want fieldline ids to join traces across logs and metrics. otherwise sampled traces look disconnected.
Sam: agree — fieldline ids are small (32-64 hex) so join keys across ES/TSDB are cheap.
Katie: what about GDPR right-to-be-forgotten? HMAC is irreversible, but if tenant requests deletion we should seed-rotate?
Marco: deletion semantics: rotate tenant key and wipe logs that are covered by retention + mark as deleted in metadata. we can't undelete but must respect legal flags.
Priya: console UX: how would this show in the log viewer? developers need to see context but not raw PII.
Marco: proposal: in console show scrubbed value + field_id + a subtle badge 'replay-safe surrogate available'. clicking shows a synthesized surrogate with clear watermark and the audit trail showing which keys were used.
Katie: can we avoid confusing product folks who expect actual inputs? need clear labels and an education nudge.
Juli: also add an ops toggle: route "debug" requests to a small dedicated debug pool (no sampling) under quota. that avoids flooding main pools.
Sam: routing ties into quotas — debug pool should have strict per-tenant caps to prevent abuse. maybe bill debug usage differently.
Priya: my main worry: leaks via embeddings/attachments. need to ensure fieldline ids are also applied to large blobs (store fingerprint rather than full id).
Marco: agreed. for attachments compute chunked fingerprints and redact thumbs. attachments get a fingerprint array to enable dedupe and correlation without content.
Katie: rollout plan?
Marco: staged:
1) telemetry-only: emit field_id + redact but don't change console  (2 weeks)
2) console preview: show surrogate, audit trail (canary) (3 weeks)
3) debug pool + routing + quota controls (4 weeks)
4) opt-in audit unredact with breakglass (enterprise) (6 weeks)
Sam: sounds reasonable. ensure feature flag per-tenant and a fast kill switch.
Priya: metrics to watch: false-positive joins (collision), developer confusion tickets, oncall escalations, legal deletion requests.
Marco: collision risk from HMAC is negligible; still we'll add a uniqueness monitor that emits an alert if duplicate field_id for different hashed prefixes appear.
Juli: ops runbook: when a user requests unredact, route through ticket + 2 approvers + 1hr TTL decryption key. log every step.
Katie: doc needed for SDK changes too. devs should be able to opt their client-side debug flag to route to debug pool (but default off).
Sam: small API change proposal for request metadata: add header X-Debug-Mode: fieldline or replay-surge. backwards compatible.
Priya: can we prototype with a middleware that adds field_id and surrogate generation? then measure perf impact.
Marco: yes I'll prototype a middleware and a small console mock. PR incoming.
Katie: +1 to prototype. can you include cost estimate for debug pool? finance wants an upper bound.
Marco: will do. rough numbers in PR.
Sam: thanks — if PR lands, i'll try the middleware on staging and validate joins with sampled traces.
Priya: tagging this for privacy review @legal-team later.
Marco: thanks everyone. I'll open the RFC + canary flag ticket.
OpsBot: ticket created: RFC-1750001234-fieldline-replay-safety (link: https://r.ticket/1750001234) :white_check_mark:
Katie: :thumbsup:
Juli: let's also add a short blurb for customer-facing support so they know what "surrogate" means.
Marco: good call. adding to the RFC.
Priya: cool — excited to see the prototype.
Sam: end of thread.
